note: Sizes are data: change them for your budget and your machine. Every report states the settings its runs used. These defaults are what Specula's own M5 runs used.

runner.note: How 'leverage.py run' starts a builder or a judge: one process, in the run's folder, that takes a prompt, runs to its end and prints what it used. {prompt} and {model} are filled in. This one is Claude Code's, with six tools and no MCP servers; put your own agent's command line here, or start agents yourself and use 'record'.

rules: Someone may be using this machine: open no window that takes the keyboard or comes to the front, and never move the pointer or press keys for them.
Anything you start that listens, listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
Stop every process you started before you finish.
